Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

4|def _components(grid, bg):
5|    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
6|    seen, result = set(), []
7|    for r in range(h):
8|        for c in range(w):
9|            color = grid[r][c]
10|            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
11|                continue
12|            q, cells = deque([(r, c)]), set()
13|            seen.add((r, c))
14|            while q:
15|                x, y = q.popleft()
16|                cells.add((x, y))
17|                for nx, ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
18|                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and (nx,ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color:
19|                        seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
20|            result.append((color, cells))
21|    return result
22|

24|def transform(grid):
25|    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
26|    counts = {}
27|    for row in grid:
28|        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
29|    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
30|    comps = _components(grid, bg)
31|    cues = []
32|    for color, cells in comps:
33|        rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
34|        r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
35|        for cr,cc in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
36|            arms = {(cr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
37|            if arms == cells and r1-r0 >= 3 and c1-c0 >= 2:
38|                # The long L is the color instruction; the target lies in its open quadrant.
39|                cues.append((max(r1-r0,c1-c0), color, cells, cr, cc, r0,r1,c0,c1))
40|    if not cues: return out
41|    _, color, cue, cr, cc, r0,r1,c0,c1 = max(cues, key=lambda x:x[0])
42|    # Empty quadrant is diagonally opposite the two arms at the L's elbow.
43|    down = cr == r0
44|    right = cc == c1
45|    candidates=[]
46|    for other, cells in comps:
47|        if cells == cue: continue
48|        sector=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if (r>cr if down else r<cr) and (c>cc if right else c<cc)]
49|        if sector:
50|            d=min(abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc) for r,c in sector)
51|            candidates.append((d,-len(sector),other,cells))
52|    if candidates:
53|        _,_,_,target=min(candidates)
54|        for r,c in target: out[r][c]=color
55|    return out
